subject: Error when fitting multi season models with colext()

messages.author: 77e0f8e9f257430f
messages.subject: Error when fitting multi season models with colext()
parts:
Hello. I'm trying to fit some multi season models with my point count data with the function colext(). I get an error saying that "(list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double' ". This is my script:

mult_occu <- read.csv("C:/Users/PC/Documents/Examensarbete/Data/HOM_redbackedshrike2015-2019.csv", header=T, dec=".", sep=";")

M <- nrow(mult_occu) #Number of sites
T <- 5 #Number of primary sample periods (number of seasons)
J <- 2 #Number of secondary sample periods (number of visits per season)

#matrix(data, nrow, ncol)
y <- matrix(mult_occu[,2:11], nrow=M, ncol=J*T) #Frequency data

obsCovs <- list(Day=mult_occu[,c("Day1.1", "Day1.2", "Day2.1", "Day2.2", "Day3.1", "Day3.2", "Day4.1", "Day4.2", "Day5.1", "Day5.2")],
                Observer=mult_occu[,c("Observer1", "Observer2", "Observer3", "Observer4", "Observer5", "Observer6", "Observer7", "Observer8", "Observer9", "Observer10")],
                Cloud=mult_occu[,c("Cloud1.1", "Cloud1.2","Cloud2.1", "Cloud2.2", "Cloud3.1", "Cloud3.2", "Cloud4.1",  "Cloud4.2", "Cloud5.1", "Cloud5.2")])

yearlySiteCovs <- list(Meadow=mult_occu[,c("Meadow1", "Meadow2", "Meadow3", "Meadow4", "Meadow5")],
                Reed=mult_occu[,c("Reed1", "Reed2", "Reed3", "Reed4", "Reed5")],
                Orchard=mult_occu[,c("Orchard1", "Orchard2","Orchard3", "Orchard4", "Orchard5")],
                Scrub=mult_occu[,c("Scrub1", "Scrub2", "Scrub3", "Scrub4", "Scrub5")],
                Settlement=mult_occu[,c("Settlement1", "Settlement2", "Settlement3", "Settlement4", "Settlement5")])

umf_mult <- unmarkedMultFrame(y=y, siteCovs=NULL, obsCovs=obsCovs, numPrimary=T, yearlySiteCovs=yearlySiteCovs)

#Dynamic models are fit with function colext() instead of occu()
#colext(~occu covariate ~colonization, ~extinction, ~det covariate, unmarkedMultFrame)
dm1_mult <- colext(~ 1 ~ 1 ~ 1 ~ 1, data = umf_mult) #Null models
dm2_mult <- colext(~ 1 ~ 1 ~ 1 ~ Day, data = umf_mult)
dm3_mult <- colext(~ 1 ~ 1 ~ 1 ~ Cloud, data = umf_mult)
dm4_mult <- colext(~ 1 ~ 1 ~ 1 ~ Observer, data = umf_mult)

When I try to fit the models I get that error. I was thinking of converting the obsCovs and siteCovs to data frames but I don't know how to keep the "categorization" that column cloud1.1, cloud1.2, cloud2.1 and so on, belongs to the category "cloud". Plus, I don't get any error when I use the unmarkedMultFrame() function before, so I interpret that as it is read successfully. That's why I don't understand the problem.
